name: N-ary Tree Postorder Traversal
description:
You are given the `root` of an n-ary tree, return the postorder traversal of its nodes' values. Nary-Tree input serialization is represented in their level order traversal. Each group of children is separated by the null value (See examples) **Example 1:** ![](https://imagedelivery.net/CLfkmk9Wzy8_9HRyug4EVA/4826173e-70d0-4412-a10e-00936d67f400/public) ```java Input: root = [1,null,3,2,4,null,5,6] Output: [5,6,3,2,4,1] ``` **Example 2:** ![](https://imagedelivery.net/CLfkmk9Wzy8_9HRyug4EVA/c0345129-6a69-4c3b-c0a5-9f3e7a45a900/public) ```java Input: root = [1,null,2,3,4,5,null,null,6,7,null,8,null,9,10,null,null,11,null,12,null,13,null,null,14] Output: [2,6,14,11,7,3,12,8,4,13,9,10,5,1] ``` **Constraints:** * `0 <= number of nodes in the tree <= 10,000` * `0 <= Node.val <= 10,000` * The height of the n-ary tree is less than or equal to `1000`. **Follow up:** Recursive solution is trivial, could you do it iteratively?
